scorecard.bottomLine: Every goal moved, none fully landed by close. Model-key matching, the Jenkins teardown and the CMB Stage bucket cleanup closed; the MEVAL DEV load, four NCTN loads and the CMB v6 load were still in flight.

goals.title: Adoption of MEVAL
goals.detail: Model-key matching closed Nov 3. MEVAL setup and the first DEV test load were in progress at close; the legacy loader comparison and Prefect access had not started.

goals.title: Close the Migration to Prefect epic
goals.detail: All remaining child work closed: Jenkins AppServers terminated in every tier and the Prefect workpool guide written (Nov 4). The epic itself is still open.

goals.title: Release NCTN Studies
goals.detail: Loads for RTOG-0617, S0819, AHOD0831 and AREN0532 were in progress at close. AREN0532 indexing and the TCIA metadata TSVs closed; the program-name correction was still in progress.

goals.title: Load CMB v6 to Stage
goals.detail: Stage bucket cleared and v1 files reconciled; therapy breaking-change frontend work closed. The CMB v6 load and image collection were on QA at close, not yet on Stage.

points.title: Tasks carried the sprint: 23 of 54 closed
points.detail: RAS upper-tier variables and the Prod deploy, Jenkins teardown, CMB bucket reconciliation, therapy breaking-change frontend work and three data model updates.

points.title: Bugs: 2 of 11 closed
points.detail: Both Study Details design QA bugs closed. Most bugs arrived mid-sprint from CMB v6 QA and the 10,000-row export issue.

points.title: User stories: 2 of 6 closed
points.detail: Age at Enrollment in days shipped. Portfolio, Program Details, Input Set and Best Response stories carry into Sprint 36.

demos.title: Program and Program Details Pages
demos.why: A new way into CTDC: browse by program, then see a program's studies, videos and materials on one page

presenters.name: Steph Singleton
presenters.focus: Walks the team through the approved designs, from the new Portfolio entry in the navigation to a program's detail page.

presenters.name: Hannah Stogsdill
presenters.focus: Designed both pages and every state: loading, error, empty, and cards with no image, link or description.

see: A Portfolio entry in the top navigation, left of Studies
One card per program, plus an Initiatives card for studies with no program, such as CMB
Program Details: description, host videos, program materials and the program's studies
Studies list rows that open Study Details, and a breadcrumb back to Portfolio
What's next: backend APIs and frontend stories for both pages are underway
demos.notes: Initiatives is a working label until NCI defines it. Host videos stay on external platforms. Modeled on the ICDC Programs page; the CTDC design system governs where they differ.

retro.timingNote: Sprint 36 started November 12 and runs to December 2. Action items from today either go into the sprint already in flight or wait for Sprint 37 planning. Decide which as we assign each one.
retro.liked: Model-key matching landed, Jenkins is gone from every tier, and the CMB Stage bucket was cleared and reconciled. Say what made those go well.
retro.lacked: Every goal moved but none fully landed by close, and CMB v6 bugs arrived mid-sprint. Name the real cause.
retro.learned: Anything about MEVAL, the CMB v6 QA loop, or moving a study from load to release.

announcements.label: CMB V6
announcements.title: CMB v6 is on QA, headed to Stage
announcements.detail: The CMB v6 data load and image collection were on QA at close, with megazip creation and indexing finishing up. CMB v6 data releases together with the therapy breaking-change code.
announcements.nextStep: QA sign-off, then promotion to Stage.

announcements.label: THERAPY UI
announcements.title: Best Response ships in two steps: first iteration now, final state in progress
announcements.detail: First iteration, shipping with CMB v6: a Best Response facet and a Participants table column on the Explore Dashboard. Final state, in progress: best response shown on the therapy that produced it, in a Therapies tab with Filter by Therapies facets.
announcements.nextStep: The first iteration goes out with the CMB v6 release; the final state replaces it in a later release.

announcements.label: BUG FIXES
announcements.title: Fixes for exports past 10,000 rows are in progress
announcements.detail: CSV export stopped at the first 10,000 records and pagination repeated rows after that. Both bugs came in mid-sprint and Nahom is working them in Sprint 36.
announcements.nextStep: Nahom shares a fix date with the team.

announcements.label: MEVAL
announcements.title: MEVAL's next steps: legacy comparison and Prefect access
announcements.detail: The first DEV test load was in progress at close. Comparing MEVAL against the legacy loader and giving its Prefect flows access to Memgraph and S3 come next.
announcements.nextStep: Eric owns the comparison; Charles owns Prefect access.

announcements.label: SPRINT 36
announcements.title: Sprint 36 is 64% carry-over
announcements.detail: 47 of its 74 tickets carried from Sprint 35, including 8 pts of Memgraph compatibility work on hold, so there is limited room for new work.
announcements.nextStep: We check what new work still fits at the Sprint 36 midpoint.
